headline: Tata Steel Limited: Scheme of Arrangement
sum: Scheme of Arrangement - Tata Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about Pronouncement of Order by the Hon ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench, approving and sanctioning the Scheme of Amalgamation amongst Tata Steel Limited…
detail: Scheme of Arrangement - Tata Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about Pronouncement of Order by the Hon ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench, approving and sanctioning the Scheme of Amalgamation amongst Tata Steel Limited and Rujuvalika Investments Limited and their respective shareholders

sources.name: NSE filing - Tata Steel Limited
sources.blurb: Primary NSE disclosure (SEBI LODR Reg. 30 / regulator filing) for this corporate event.
